title: Mason Finding
description: A single finding from a Mason code health audit. All findings in commercial mode should have status: fixed before the report is delivered.

id.description: Sequential finding ID. M-001, M-002, etc.

dimension.description: Which of the five scoring dimensions this finding belongs to.

severity.description: must = blocks deployment; should = fix in this engagement; consider = optional improvement.

headline.description: One sentence a non-developer can read and understand. 'Loop loads records one-by-one — will fail on large orders.' Not 'Governance violation in saveRecord handler.'

problem.description: 1-2 sentences: what was wrong, and what could go wrong because of it. Written for the business owner, not the developer.

fix.description: 1-2 sentences: what Softype changed, and why it's better now. No jargon.

line_refs.description: Line numbers where the issue appears. Optional but helpful.

before_code.description: The problematic code snippet. Keep it short — 3-15 lines. Enough to show the problem, not the entire file.

after_code.description: The fixed code snippet. Same scope as before_code.

tests_added.description: Number of test cases added to cover this finding. Should be > 0 for all must and should findings.

status.description: Commercial mode deliverable: all findings must be fixed before the report is presented to the customer.
